description: A two way crossover that splits audio into a low band and a high band with fourth order Linkwitz-Riley filters

params.text: Sets the crossover frequency, marked in Hz, from 10Hz upwards
Attenuverts the frequency modulation input, -1 to +1

inputs.text: Modulates the crossover frequency through its attenuverter, 1V per octave at full attenuverter
The audio to be split; its channel count sets the polyphony

outputs.text: The band above the crossover frequency
The band below the crossover frequency

notes: the two bands sum back to a flat frequency response, so several of these can be chained to make any number of bands
